name: 8085 8-bit Addition
desc: This program adds two 8-bit numbers and displays the result or an error message based on the carry flag.

files.sketch.ino:
;Load 9BH and A7H in registers D & E respectively.
; Add the numbers. If some is grater than FFH
; display 01H at output port 00,Otherwise,
; display the sum add output port 01.

ORG 5000H           ; Program starting address

MVI D, 9BH          ; Load 9BH directly into Register D
MVI E, A7H          ; Load A7H directly into Register E

MOV A, D            ; Move contents of D to Accumulator (A = 9BH)
ADD E               ; Add contents of E to Accumulator (A = A + E)

JC DISPLAY          ; If Carry flag = 1 (Sum > FFH), jump to DISPLAY
OUT 01H             ; Otherwise, display the valid sum at Port 01H
HLT                 ; Terminate the program

DISPLAY:
MVI A, 01H          ; Load 01H into Accumulator
OUT 00H             ; Display 01H at Port 00H
HLT                 ; Terminate the program
